comments.text:
A person from Guadalajara here. We lived thru one of the most distressing times in my city's history yesterday. The situation is still dire and the city is completely paralyzed right now. Feels like if we're hostages and there's this tug-o-war between narcos and the Mexican armed forces. Sadly, the federal government is downplaying the situation and trying to save face, but there's still shit going on and blockades surrounding the city. Almost all roads leading to Guadalajara have something going on, some of them under control, some of them with army presence, but with something happening nonetheless.

I've never seen the city this deserted. Feels eerie, like a zombie movie. Almost everyone is locked in place in their houses and well just standing by, waiting for something to happen. Almost all businesses closed. This has never happened before, not even in the global pandemic.

Thank God things are really really slowly coming back to normal near the city center, but there's still a lot to do... a lot more yet to come.

Never in the history of organized crime has cutting the head of the organization worked. This will not be the exception. Just like in Sinaloa with el Chapo and then el Mayo, there will be blood with the reorganization. And as it happens with this kind of things, the common person will take the brunt. Thanks for covering, Phil. Please people, keep an eye on this. This is Mexico's 2nd biggest city. This cannot be normalized.
